name: Fighter Road Warrior
body:
Whether serving as bodyguards in a dystopian future, patrolling the streets of a civilized society, or serving as the leader of a hard-bitten gang of bikers, road warriors combine martial prowess with the mobility of advanced technological vehicles.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

The road warrior gains proficiency in dire flails and spiked chains but is not proficient with heavy armor or tower shields.

Mechanical Expert (Ex)

A road warrior gains 2 bonus skill points per level that must be spent on Craft (mechanical) and Knowledge (engineering).

Bonded Mech (Ex)

The road warrior gains a bonded mech*, treating his class level as his pilot level.

This ability replaces the bonus feats normally gained at 1st, 4th, 8th, 12th, and 16th levels.

Full-Throttle Combatant (Ex)

Starting at 2nd level, the road warrior gains a +1 bonus on Will saves against fear and to Acrobatics checks attempted while driving. This bonus increases by +1 for every four levels beyond 2nd.

This ability replaces, but otherwise counts as, the fighter’s bravery class feature.

Moving Target (Ex)

At 7th level, whenever the road warrior is driving his mech and moves at least 30 feet in a round, both he and his mech gain a +2 dodge bonus to AC until the start of his next turn. If the road warrior’s mech has the nitroboost Mech Enhancement and he activates it before or during his movement, he instead gains a +4 dodge bonus to AC from this ability. The road warrior never gains the ability to move at his normal speed while wearing heavy armor from the armor training class feature.
